common.willRetranslate: This will be machine-translated from the text above when you save. Type here to use your own translation instead.

submitList.sortHint: Quantity sorts on the last known count, so rows stay put while you type.
submitList.hiddenEntries: {count} item(s) you entered are hidden by the search — all of them are still included when you submit.
submitList.incompleteTitle: Not every item has a quantity
submitList.incompleteBody: {done} of {total} items have a quantity. Are you sure you want to submit? If you don't have any of an item, enter 0.

login.title: Inventory Management
login.subtitle: Demo login — pick a user to impersonate. (Entra ID sign-in replaces this in production.)
login.accessHelp: Access is granted by your administrator. If you cannot sign in, ask them to check your account.
login.demoDesc: This list is not shown in production. Set AUTH_PROVIDER=entra to hide it locally.

magic.label: Your email address
magic.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Click the button in that email to sign in. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magic.error: Something went wrong sending that link. Try again, or contact your administrator if it keeps happening.
magic.resent: We sent a new link. Use the newest email — older links no longer work.
magic.spamHint: Can't find it? Check your Spam or Junk folder. It can take a minute to arrive.

errors.invalid: Enter your full email address, like name@company.com.
errors.notfound: We couldn't find an account for {email}. Check the spelling, or ask your administrator to add you.
errors.internal: {email} is a company staff account. Staff sign in with Microsoft, not by email.
errors.inactive: The account for {email} has been turned off. Contact your administrator.
errors.partnerdisabled: Your organization's access to this app is turned off. Contact your administrator.
errors.ratelimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.mailfailed: We couldn't send the email just now. Please try again in a moment.

error.title: We couldn't sign you in
error.config: Microsoft sign-in isn't set up on this site yet. Contact your administrator.
error.entra: Microsoft couldn't complete the sign-in. Please try again; if it keeps happening, contact your administrator.
error.state: That sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
error.nocode: Microsoft didn't finish the sign-in. Please try again.
error.noidentity: Microsoft did not return an identity we could match. Contact your administrator.
error.unprovisioned: This account doesn't have access to this app. If you have another work account, try that one; otherwise ask your administrator to add you.
error.nolink: That sign-in link was incomplete. Enter your email below to get a new one.
error.linkexpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Enter your email below to get a new one.
error.mailfailed: We could not send the sign-in email. Please try again in a moment.
error.sessionexpired: For your security you were signed out. Please sign in again.
error.partnerdisabled: Your organization's access to this app has been disabled. Contact your administrator.

partner.title: Grower or vendor?
partner.body: Enter the email address your administrator registered for you. We'll email you a sign-in link — no password needed.

staff.title: Company staff?
staff.body: Sign in with your work Microsoft account.

form.title: Submit inventory
form.description: Record today's on-hand counts and manage orders. Save a draft anytime; numbers only count once you submit.
form.noItems: No items are authorized for your grower yet. Ask an admin to authorize items.
form.loadPreviousHint: Most counts don't change day to day — start from your last submitted values and edit what moved.
form.weekChangeTitle: Change vs the same item a week ago
form.locationHint: Counts are recorded against the selected location.
form.noLocations: No locations are mapped to your grower yet. Ask an admin to map at least one location before submitting counts.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.noVendors: No vendors mapped to this item.
orders.cancelDesc: Cancel this order from {vendor}? It won't count as received.

actions.notAuthorized: You're not authorized for this item.
actions.invalidVendor: Choose a valid vendor for this item.
actions.alreadyClosed: That order is no longer open.
actions.deliveryTooSoon: {vendor} needs at least {days} day(s) from the order date. The earliest delivery date is {date}.
actions.deliveryBeforeOrder: The delivery date can't be before the order date.
actions.orderDateFuture: The order date can't be in the future.

orders.receivedHint: Prefilled with what you ordered — change it only if something is off.
orders.receiptNoteHint: Ignored when the quantity matches what was ordered.
orders.orderDateHint: Today, or earlier if you placed it before entering it here.
orders.leadTimeHint: {vendor} needs at least {days} day(s), so the earliest is {date}.
orders.vendorDateNote: The vendor has confirmed delivery for {date}.

requests.title: Missing item requests
requests.description: Request items you need that aren't in your authorized list.
requests.dialogDesc: An admin will review and may add it to your list.

actions.draftSaved: Draft saved ({count} item(s)). Submit to record them.
actions.noItems: Enter at least one item quantity first.
actions.noAuthorized: No authorized items in this submission.
actions.locationNotAllowed: That location is not mapped to your grower.

flagHistory.title: Flag history
flagHistory.description: Every time you turned on "Low" for an item, and how it ended.

items.title: My items
items.description: Everything you're authorized to count, what you hold at each location, and what's on order.

form.title: Submit supply report
form.description: Report the quantity you have for each item, and optionally break it down per grower.
form.over: Allocated total exceeds the item quantity.
form.overBlocked: {count} item(s) allocate more than they report — fix them before submitting.
form.noItems: No items are mapped to your vendor yet. Ask an admin to map items.
form.loadPreviousHint: Most reports don't change week to week — start from your last reported quantities and grower allocations, and edit what moved.

history.title: Report history
history.description: Your past supply reports and grower allocations.

actions.noItems: Enter at least one item quantity first.
actions.noSupplied: No supplied items in this submission.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Orders growers have placed with you. Confirm a delivery date for each: the grower is told, and delivery is measured against it.
orders.leadTimeHint: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this many days after the order date. Items can have their own lead time on My items. Leave blank for no minimum.
orders.leadTimeExplain: Applies to every item unless that item has its own lead time on My items.

actions.closed: That order is no longer open.
actions.beforeOrder: The delivery date can't be before the order date.
actions.confirmed: Delivery date confirmed. The grower has been notified.
actions.changed: Delivery date changed. The grower has been notified.
actions.leadTimeInvalid: Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 365.

items.title: My items
items.description: Everything you supply, your latest reported stock, and how you ship each item (your conversions).
items.chainHint: How you pack this item for shipping. It never changes an ordered quantity.
items.noChainsDefined: No conversion chain is defined for {category} yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
items.ratiosHint: Comma-separated, innermost first: how many {base} fit in the first level, then how many of those in the next.
items.leadTimeLabel: Minimum lead time for this item (days)
items.leadTimeHint: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this many days after ordering this item. Leave blank to use your default ({days} days).
items.leadTimeHintNoDefault: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this many days after ordering this item. Leave blank for no minimum.

email.footer: Automated message from the Inventory Management system. Please do not reply to this email.

submissionReceived.subject: Inventory submission received — {grower} ({location})
submissionReceived.heading: Inventory submission received
submissionReceived.intro: A daily inventory count was just submitted for {grower} by {submittedBy}.

vendorSubmissionReceived.subject: Supply report received — {vendor}
vendorSubmissionReceived.heading: Supply report received
vendorSubmissionReceived.intro: A supply report was just submitted for {vendor} by {submittedBy}.

scheduledReminder.subject: Reminder: submit your inventory count — {grower}
scheduledReminder.heading: Time to submit your inventory count
scheduledReminder.intro: {grower} has not submitted an inventory count in {overdue}. Please update your on-hand counts so stock stays accurate.

missingItemRequest.subject: New item request — {grower}
missingItemRequest.heading: New item request
missingItemRequest.intro: {requestedBy} at {grower} requested a new item to be added to their authorized list.

requestReviewed.subject: Your item request was reviewed — {item}
requestReviewed.heading: Your item request was reviewed
requestReviewed.intro: Your request for "{item}" has been reviewed and is now marked {status}.

lowInventoryReviewed.subject: Low-inventory flag reviewed — {item}
lowInventoryReviewed.heading: Low-inventory flag reviewed
lowInventoryReviewed.intro: An admin has reviewed the low-inventory flag you raised for "{item}". It has been cleared from your list.

orderPlaced.subject: Order placed — {item}
orderPlaced.heading: Order placed
orderPlaced.intro: Your order for "{item}" has been placed with {vendor}.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Inventory Management
magicLink.intro: Use the button below to sign in. No password needed.
magicLink.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can only be used once. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

vendorOrderPlaced.subject: New order to confirm — {item} for {grower}
vendorOrderPlaced.heading: New order: please confirm a delivery date
vendorOrderPlaced.intro: {grower} placed an order with {vendor} for {item}. Please confirm the date you can deliver it.

orderConfirmed.subject: Delivery date confirmed — {item}
orderConfirmed.heading: Delivery date confirmed
orderConfirmed.intro: {vendor} confirmed delivery of your order for {item} on {date}.

orderDateChanged.subject: Delivery date changed — {item}
orderDateChanged.heading: Delivery date changed
orderDateChanged.intro: {vendor} changed the delivery date of your order for {item} to {date} (it was {previous}).

vendorScheduledReminder.subject: Reminder: submit your supply report — {vendor}
vendorScheduledReminder.heading: Time to submit your supply report
vendorScheduledReminder.intro: {vendor} has not submitted a supply report in {overdue}. Please report your current quantities so stock stays accurate.

conversions.mappingNotFound: That item mapping was not found.
conversions.cleared: Conversions cleared. This item ships in plain units.
conversions.chainNotFound: That conversion chain was not found.
conversions.wrongCategory: That chain belongs to category {chain}, but this item is in {item}.
conversions.levelCount: Enter one quantity per level: this chain has {count} ({levels}).
conversions.wholeNumbers: Each quantity must be a whole number of 1 or more.

items.spanishNameHelp: Shown to growers and vendors who use Spanish. Leave blank to machine-translate on save.
items.legacyIdHelp: Optional. The item's ID in the legacy (Famous) system — no two items can share one.
items.photoHelp: Optional. Shown in the items list and to the growers and vendors who work with this item.
items.notesHelp: Shown to growers and vendors under the item, in their language.
items.spanishNotesHelp: Leave blank to machine-translate on save; changing the English notes re-translates. Anything typed here is used as-is and marked reviewed.
items.itemIdPlaceholder: Pick a commodity and a category to see the ID
items.itemIdHelp: Generated on save — the number is the next one available.
items.deleteDescription: Delete {id}? This cannot be undone. If it has history, deactivate it instead.
items.searchPlaceholder: Search by ID, name or legacy ref…
items.newItemHelp: The item ID is generated from the commodity and category.

imageField.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
imageField.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Large photos are resized automatically.

commodities.spanishNameHelp: Shown to growers and vendors who use Spanish. Leave blank to machine-translate on save.
commodities.disableDescription: Its {count} item(s) disappear from grower and vendor screens, pickers and current reports until it is enabled again. The items themselves are not changed.
commodities.enableDescription: Its {count} item(s) come back exactly as they were — items that were inactive on their own stay inactive.

itemsDialog.title: Items in {code} — {name}
itemsDialog.descriptionActive: {count} item(s). Status is each item's own setting.
itemsDialog.descriptionDisabled: {count} item(s). This commodity is disabled, so all of them are hidden from growers and vendors until it is enabled again. Status is each item's own setting.
itemsDialog.searchPlaceholder: Search ID, legacy ID or name…

categories.title: Material categories
categories.description: Categories that group items (boxes, bags, labels…).
categories.codeHelp: Material category code, e.g. BX. Pick one that isn't in the list.
categories.spanishNameHelp: The unit growers and vendors who use Spanish see ("350 Cajas"). Leave blank to machine-translate on save.

subCategories.description: Finer grouping within a material category.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Shared lookup behind an item's country of origin, a location's country, a vendor's home country, and vendor supply-to lists.
countries.nameHelp: Used by an item's country of origin, a location's country, a vendor's home country, and vendor supply-to lists.
countries.selectableHelp: Turn off for placeholder rows like N/A. They stay available as an item's country of origin but are hidden from location, vendor and supply-to pickers.
countries.inUse: {name} is in use ({items} item(s), {locations} location(s), {lists} vendor supply list(s)) and cannot be deleted until those are changed.

conversions.description: How a SKU converts into shipping units (Bags → Boxes → Cases). Chains define the structure only — each vendor supplies their own ratios, on the vendor↔item mapping or from their portal.
conversions.materialCategoryHelp: The chain starts from this category — it is what the item's quantities are counted in, and it labels the innermost level.
conversions.levelsHelp: Comma-separated, innermost first. No quantities here — vendors supply those.

dashboard.description: Operations overview across growers, vendors and master data.

lowInventory.title: Low inventory
lowInventory.description: What growers have flagged, and what is actually below threshold right now.
lowInventory.currentIntro: Computed live from the latest count per item and location against the effective threshold (a grower override where one exists, otherwise the global one). Nothing here needs clearing — rows leave on their own once the next count comes in above threshold.
lowInventory.flagsIntro: Flags growers raised by hand. Reviewing one clears it and notifies the grower; it then disappears from their view.
lowInventory.historyIntro: Every flag growers have raised with the “Low” toggle — still open, unflagged by the grower, or cleared by an admin review — with the on-hand total when it was raised next to the total now.

itemMessages.title: Item messages
itemMessages.description: Notices shown under a specific item to growers, vendors or both — everyone mapped to the item, or a selected few.
itemMessages.growersHint: Only growers authorized for the selected item. Others would never see the message.
itemMessages.vendorsHint: Only vendors mapped to the selected item. Others would never see the message.
itemMessages.spanishNoteHint: Leave blank to machine-translate the note on save; changing the English note re-translates it. Anything typed here is used as-is and marked reviewed. Spanish-language growers and vendors see this instead of the English note.

locations.description: Physical sites where inventory is held.
locations.typeDescription: Determines whether this site can be mapped to growers, vendors, or either. A location with no type is pickable by neither. Manage the list at Location types.

locationTypes.description: The kinds of site a location can be. Each type decides whether growers, vendors or both can use it.
locationTypes.deleteInUse: {count} site(s) use this type, so it cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
locationTypes.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? No sites are using it.
locationTypes.usedByDescription: Decides which side can attach a site of this type. Changing it can remove sites from a picker they currently appear in.
locationTypes.orderDescription: Position in the dropdown. Lower comes first.
locationTypes.activeDescription: Inactive types are hidden when creating a site, but sites already using them keep working.

growers.description: Grower organizations and their inventory access.
growers.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? If it has users or history, set status Inactive instead.
growers.locationsDescription: Grower-side sites only. Drives the location picker on the grower's submit page — a grower needs at least one to submit counts.

vendors.description: Suppliers and the items they provide.
vendors.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? If it has users or history, set status Inactive instead.
vendors.countryHqDescription: Where the vendor is based. Their facility's country comes from the location below and can differ.
vendors.locationsDescription: Vendor-side sites only. The vendor's region(s) are read from here.
vendors.leadTimeDescription: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this after ordering. Items can override it (Mappings → Vendors, or the vendor's My items page). The vendor can also set this default from their Orders page.
vendors.itemsDescription: Filtered by the material categories above. Removing a category also removes its items from this selection.

users.description: Onboard internal users and map external users to a grower or vendor.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? If they have submission history, set Active off instead.
users.growerDescription: Required for grower users. Leave empty for any other role.
users.vendorDescription: Required for vendor users. Leave empty for any other role.

mappings.description: Which items each grower may submit for, and which items each vendor supplies.
mappings.growerDialogDescription: Pick a grower to load what it can access today, then adjust.
mappings.growerItemsDescription: Ticked items are the grower's current authorizations. Unticking one deactivates it (kept for history); the row list still shows it as Inactive.
mappings.vendorDialogDescription: Pick a vendor to load what it supplies today, then adjust.
mappings.vendorItemsDescription: Ticked items are what the vendor supplies today. Unticking one deactivates the mapping — its conversion setup is kept, so re-ticking later restores it.
mappings.removeMappingConfirm: Remove {item} from {name}? Its conversion setup is removed too.
mappings.leadTimeHint: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this after ordering this item from this vendor. Leave blank to use the vendor default ({default}).
mappings.chainDescription: Describes how this vendor ships the item. It never changes the ordered quantity.
mappings.noChainDefined: No chain is defined for category {code}. Add one under Conversions first.
mappings.ratiosHint: Comma-separated, innermost first: how many {base} per {inner}.
mappings.ratiosHintNext: Comma-separated, innermost first: how many {base} per {inner}, then how many {inner} per {outer}.

reports.description: Current stock on both sides of the supply chain, the order book between them, and the embedded Power BI analytics. The three are separate views — they are not meant to add up.

growerStock.empty: No growers have authorized items matching these filters.

vendorStock.empty: No vendors have mapped items matching these filters.
vendorStock.emptyHeld: No vendor is currently holding any of these items for that grower. Note this filter only looks at each vendor's latest report.

powerBi.notAvailableCount: {count} of {total} reports are not available yet
powerBi.cantShow: This report can’t be shown right now. Please contact your administrator.
powerBi.signInToView: Sign in with Microsoft to view this report.

entraNotConfigured.title: Some reports are not available
entraNotConfigured.body: Microsoft sign-in is not set up here, so secured reports cannot load. Please contact your administrator.

cacheNotConfigured.title: Some reports are not available
cacheNotConfigured.body: Secured reports are not set up yet. Please contact your administrator.

noSession.title: Sign in with Microsoft to view these reports
noSession.body: You signed in without Microsoft, so secured reports cannot load.

consentRequired.title: Power BI access has not been approved yet
consentRequired.body: Your administrator needs to approve this app's access to Power BI.

failed.title: Could not reach Power BI
failed.body: The reports below could not be loaded. Please try again later, or contact your administrator if this continues.

powerBi.embedError: Power BI could not load this report.
powerBi.loadFailed: This report could not be loaded.

auditLogs.title: Audit logs
auditLogs.description: Every create / update / delete / export by internal users.
auditLogs.empty: No audit entries match your filters.

outbox.description: Every email the app has queued or sent. Emails are sent in the background, a few at a time.

schedulers.title: Email schedulers
schedulers.description: Reminder cadences for growers and vendors who haven't submitted. A one-grower or one-vendor schedule overrides its default.
schedulers.whoRemindsHelp: A one-grower or one-vendor schedule replaces the default for that grower or vendor.
schedulers.remindAfterDaysHelp: Used only when cadence is After N days. Daily / Weekly / Monthly imply 1 / 7 / 30 days.

note.intro: “{run}” runs the same check the daily Container Apps job runs.
note.after: (one per overdue grower or vendor per day); they are then sent in the background at whatever rate the mail provider allows, so a large batch drains over several minutes rather than being rejected. “{send}” runs one of those passes immediately.

thresholds.title: Item thresholds
thresholds.description: Low-stock thresholds. Grower-specific values override the global default. Quantities are always in the item's material category.
